title: Stretch: The German School System
welcome_lead: Compare your school with the German system — Gymnasium, Abitur and uniforms (or lack of!).

walkthroughs.body_html:
After die Grundschule (ages 6-10), students go to one of three schools:

  • das Gymnasium — most academic, leads to Abitur at 18.
  • die Realschule — middle track, ends at year 10.
  • die Hauptschule — vocational focus, ends at year 9.

Many regions now combine these into die Gesamtschule.

Useful comparisons:

  • In Deutschland gibt es keine Schuluniform. — In Germany there's no uniform.
  • Die Schule beginnt früher, oft um acht Uhr. — School starts earlier, often at 8.
  • Der Schultag endet meistens am Mittag. — School day usually ends at midday.
  • Man bekommt Noten von 1 bis 6. — You get grades from 1 to 6 (1 = best).

Useful structures:

  • Ich möchte das Abitur machen. — I want to do A-levels.
  • Nach der Schule will ich studieren. — After school I want to study.
  • Ich werde eine Ausbildung machen. — I'll do an apprenticeship.

The future intent verbs will, möchte, werde all push the second verb to the end.
